name: Settlement Data 2
definition: Provides information on the settlement of a treasury trade.

CashFlowUniqueReference.name: Cash Flow Unique Reference
CashFlowUniqueReference.definition: Unique reference supplied by the trade processing system.

SettlementSystemUniqueReference.name: Settlement System Unique Reference
SettlementSystemUniqueReference.definition: Unique reference assigned by a settlement system.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Original amount which should be settled. This information should be provided when the trade is partially settled or when the settlement is rejected.

SettledAmount.name: Settled Amount
SettledAmount.definition: Funds which the trading side is expected to receive.

RejectedAmount.name: Rejected Amount
RejectedAmount.definition: Amount that cannot be settled by a settlement system.

PayingParty.name: Paying Party
PayingParty.definition: Specifies the party that pays the settlement amount.

ReceivingParty.name: Receiving Party
ReceivingParty.definition: Specifies the party that receives the settlement amount.

SettlementDate.name: Settlement Date
SettlementDate.definition: Date on which the settlement is due to settle.

SettlementStatus.name: Settlement Status
SettlementStatus.definition: Specifies the status of a settlement eg rejected, settled or awaiting authorisation.

ExtendedSettlementStatus.name: Extended Settlement Status
ExtendedSettlementStatus.definition: Description of the status of the settlement of a trade when no coded form is available.

SettlementStatusSubType.name: Settlement Status Sub Type
SettlementStatusSubType.definition: Additional information about the cause of the rejection of a settlement.
